title: Section 8 Arbitration Act — Refer the suit to arbitration - educational example

content.body: Educational example, not an official statutory illustration and not a decided case. Use only the law already recorded in this topic file. Recorded point for Section 8 Arbitration Act — Refer the suit to arbitration: If a suit is filed on a matter covered by an arbitration agreement, the court must refer the parties to arbitration on a timely application, unless prima facie there is no valid agreement.
